<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_80C_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock_zCjyqm5WluR3" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>NOTE 3: <span id="xdx_828_zs7iPTULAm2c">RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Equity Sale to TZP</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On March 21, 2025, the Board of Directors approved
an equity financing and issued <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--SharesIssued_c20250321__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_pd" title="Shares issued">500,000</span> shares of Senior Preferred Stock to TZP Group Investments, L.P. at a purchase price of $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--InvestmentCompanyPurchasePremiumPerShare_c20260301__20260321__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_zRLmdeWHwiU7" title="Purchase price">10.00</span> per
share, including participation by an entity affiliated with directors Jo-Anne Kruse and Marc Schneider, who are affiliated with TZP Group
Holdings, L.P. and its related entities; after considering the terms of the financing and the related party relationships involved, the
Board determined that the transaction is fair and in the best interests of the Company and its stockholders and was conducted on terms
consistent with those that would be expected in an arm&#8217;s-length transaction. See discussion of the related redemption price of the
preferred stock in Note 7. Series A holders&#8217; presently exercisable right to compel redemption of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--PreferredStockRedemptionAmount_c20250321__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_pp0p" title="Preferred stock redemption value">21,305,887</span>.</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>




<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"></p>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Management Fees</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company pays management fees and reimburses
expenses to TZP Group Investments Manager, LP. Management fees and other expenses of $<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--FeesAndOtherExpenses_c20260401__20260630__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_pp0p" title="Fees and other expenses">50,000</span> and $<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--FeesAndOtherExpenses_c20260101__20260630__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_pp0p" title="Fees and other expenses">102,141</span> &#160;&#160;&#160;were incurred
for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, respectively, and $<span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--FeesAndOtherExpenses_c20250401__20250630__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_pp0p" title="Fees and other expenses">50,000</span> and $<span id="xdx_909_ecustom--FeesAndOtherExpenses_c20250101__20250630__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsL.PMember_pp0p" title="Fees and other expenses">100,000</span> for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025,
respectively. These fees are included in general and administrative expenses on the Company&#8217;s condensed consolidated statements
of operations and other comprehensive income (loss).</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for related party transactions. Examples of related party transactions include transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiary; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) and entity and its principal owners; and (d) affiliates.</p></div>
